title: How pandemics end
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
At what point can society say that a pandemic has truly ended?
Why do some people return to normal behaviour earlier than others during a long health crisis?
Should temporary emergency rules automatically expire after a certain period?
What lessons from one pandemic should governments preserve for the next one?
How can societies remember a major health crisis without remaining afraid of it?
